criteria.text: Given nothing has been configured, When I check, Then first-run is reported per layer and becomes false once a setting is written
Given the plan is read, Then settings are grouped, locked rows are marked and never offered as choices, and each row shows value vs default and whether it changed
Given I accept the defaults, When onboarding finishes, Then no settings file is required for correct behavior
Given a personal mute, When sound is resolved, Then it mutes only on an explicit false and never overrides repo sounds.json or the env var
Given every schema setting, When the plan is built, Then each appears exactly once across the groups
